lines.en: I take a heavy step at a time.
This armor of mine is welded on.
My steps pack the soil down.
I go around a sapling.
My joints sound as I walk.
I climb the slope, working hard.
I pass between the rocks.
My weight sinks the ground.

lines.zh: 我一步一步朝工作的地方走。
lines.en: I walk step by step toward the work.

lines.zh: 我把肩上的工具挪了挪。
lines.en: I shift the tool on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这身铁一步一响，往坡上去。
lines.en: This iron body clanks up the slope, step by step.
I turn around and head back.
I stand like a heap of iron.
Two barrels sit on my shoulders.
I tap my belly plate and listen.
I'm mapping where the ore lies.
Wind through my armor echoes.
I can rest standing; I don't tire.

lines.zh: 细小的眼，足够辨认矿脉。
lines.en: Small eyes are enough to pick out a seam.

lines.zh: 我伸手敲了敲自己的胸口。
lines.en: I knock on my own chest.
There's plenty worth digging here.

lines.zh: 我把头转过去，甲片一片响。
lines.en: I turn my head and my plates rasp one by one.

lines.zh: 我站了半刻，脚下的土陷了。
lines.en: I've stood a while; the dirt has sunk under me.
I work a fist open and shut.
There's still heat in my barrels.
I hear echoes under the ground.
What are you standing here for?

lines.zh: 你伸直双臂，还没我肩宽。
lines.en: Your arms spread wide still don't match my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我把肩上的管口对着你。
lines.en: I point my barrels at you.
Have you come looking for ore?
I'm working this road.
You're in the way of my material.
I look down at your hands.

lines.zh: 你腰上的铁，比你的肉多。
lines.en: There's more iron on your belt than flesh.
I don't mind you standing there.
You move first; then my muzzle turns.
Your boots are caked in mud.
I'm wondering how much you can carry.
There's stone all under this road.
The ground under me is solid.
I raise my barrels slowly.
Don't stand right in front of me.
I give a step and my armor dents.

lines.zh: 关节里卡了东西，抬不利索。
lines.en: Something's jammed in my joint; it won't lift right.
I can't lift one arm.
I'm still standing, not down.
The iron on me cracks.
I drop to one knee to steady myself.
My armor's too heavy; I prop myself on one arm.
I've no words, only noise.

lines.zh: 我撑着膝盖，把身子撑回来。
lines.en: I brace on my knee and haul myself upright.
I can still work with this.
Is that scrap iron?
I look at it and take it.
I can eat this stuff.
The iron tastes right.
Not enough for a day's work.
This rusty scrap has just the right bite.
I feed it into the port on my shoulder.
When I've eaten I feel heavier.
I'll keep this small piece.
I sweep the fragments into a pile.
I keep the fragments too.
That much only fills a gap.
You hit my armor; you're the one who recoils.

lines.zh: 这一下我的甲响了一声。
lines.en: My armor rings once.
I lift a foot to give room.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲把你顶了出去。
lines.en: My shoulder plate shoves you back.
Soil squeezes out under our feet.
I settle the barrels on my shoulders.
I keep my balance and don't fall.
This weight isn't for nothing.
I slowly turn half about.
I walk on toward the site.
She's sturdily built too.

lines.zh: 我们的甲互相碰了一下。
lines.en: Our armor knocks together.
Her barrels are shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起搬同一根木头。
lines.en: We carry the same beam together.
She goes first and clears the way.
Neither of us talks while working.
She hands me a chunk of ore.
We sit and divide the scrap.
I know this place, and so does she.
She's still digging after dark.
I bend and pick it up.
It has weight in my hand.
I drop it in the basket on my back.
I tap it with a nail.
This ore is decent quality.
Heavier than it looks.
I toss it on the pile.
Too small; I leave it.
I shoulder it.
I count how many are left.
Something is coming at me.
I swing my barrels round.

lines.zh: 我抢先一步，堵住矿道口。
lines.en: I take one stride and block the mine entrance.
That won't stop a blast.

lines.zh: 手臂抬起，炮口跟着转过来。
lines.en: My arm rises and the muzzle swings around with it.
This seam is mine to work.

lines.zh: 脚掌抓地，炮口抬起来了。
lines.en: Feet dig in, and the muzzle comes up.
I'm lining you up.
You'd better not move.
Next shot, I won't aim wide.
My barrels are heating up.
This one's coming now.

lines.zh: 我每挪一步，地就低一分。
lines.en: Every step I take sinks the ground a little.
I carry too much iron to move fast.
You're in the shaft; you won't get far.
I line the barrels up on you.
I wait for a gap.
My shadow covers you.
You've backed to the shaft wall.
This one will bring the wall down too.
I pull the trigger.
The noise is enormous in this tunnel.
Dust has blinded me.
You're in range now; you can't back out.
My fist lands on the ground and earth bursts up.

lines.zh: 这一臂抡圆了砸在你护胸上。
lines.en: I swing my arm full circle into your chestplate.

lines.zh: 我肩上的管口同时响了。
lines.en: Both barrels fire at once.
The ground takes a crater.
The blast shoves you back a few paces.
I grab your arm.
I drive an elbow into your back.
You hit my armor and it does nothing.

lines.zh: 第二拳落在同一处裂口。
lines.en: The second fist lands on the same crack.
Half a finger snaps off.
You slide to the ground.
I stoop to look at you.

lines.zh: 我落到地上，震起一层土。
lines.en: I land and a layer of dust jumps.
This body is built of iron.
I turn my barrels this way.
I knock on my own armor.
There's plenty hidden under here.
I crouch and take a fistful of soil.
There are flecks of ore in it.

lines.zh: 我咬碎一块矿渣，咽了下去。
lines.en: I crush a lump of slag and swallow it.
I stand and study the lie of the land.
I head for the hillside.

lines.zh: 我从坡顶下来，土往下滚。
lines.en: I come down the slope and dirt rolls ahead of me.
There's work to be done today.
Fire heats my armor until it burns.
I come down and make a crater.
Water gets in my barrels and I choke.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪让我侧翻过去。
lines.en: The blast wave rolls me onto my side.

lines.zh: 箭头断在接缝里，我拔不出。
lines.en: The arrowhead snapped off in a seam; I can't pull it out.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的关节卡住。
lines.en: The light seizes up my joints.

lines.zh: 没吃废料，我的动作变慢。
lines.en: No scrap to eat, and my movements slow.
Lightning runs all round my iron.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，我这身重量往下坠。
lines.en: No ground below; all this weight drops.
